items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries of the same event both checking the Set before either records it, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says dedup uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that replaying a signed delivery with a different header bypasses deduplication.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers refund.created, so real refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
